fields.name: LWt_2022-04-21
fields.title: LWt_2022-04-21
fields.description: Liveweight (kg) recorded on the date shown in the column name (YYYY-MM-DD). Blank/missing values mean the animal was not assigned to the plot on that date. Because animals were weighed when entering and leaving plots, gaps between an animals first and last recorded weights indicate it was temporarily removed from the plot and replaced; the off-plot period can be inferred from the nearest previous and subsequent LWt_(date) columns with recorded weights. During off-plot periods, animals grazed the same field but outside the experimental boundary. Values coded as NA indicate the animal was on the plot but was not weighed on that date.

fields.title: LWt_2025-04-07
fields.description: Liveweight (kg) recorded on the date shown in the column name (YYYY-MM-DD). Blank/missing values mean the animal was not assigned to the plot on that date. Because animals were weighed when entering and leaving plots, gaps between an animals first and last recorded weights indicate it was temporarily removed from the plot and replaced; the off-plot period can be inferred from the nearest previous and subsequent LWt_(date) columns with recorded weights. During off-plot periods, animals grazed the same field but outside the experimental boundary. Values coded as NA indicate the animal was on the plot but was not weighed on that date.

fields.name: LW_Gain
fields.title: LW_Gain
fields.description: Cumulative liveweight gained on the experimental plots. Liveweight gain during any period that they were removed from the plot is not included.

fields.name: Days
fields.title: Days
fields.description: Cumulative number of days that the animals grazed in the experimental plots, which excludes any period over which they had been removed from the plots.

fields.name: DLWG
fields.title: DLWG
fields.description: Daily liveweight gain. Calculated as LW_Gain/Days

fields.name: LW_gain/ha
fields.title: LW_gain/ha
fields.description: Cumulative liveweight gain per hectare. Calculated as LW_Gain/plot area, where plot area was 1ha for the cell grazing plots (Plot_ID starting with a T) and 1.75 ha for the set-stocking plots (Plot_ID starting with a C)

fields.name: LW_gain/ha/day
fields.title: LW_gain/ha/day
fields.description: Cumulative liveweight gain per hectare per day. Calculated as LW_gain/ha/days, Where days are the cumulative number of days the animals grazed the experimental plots.

fields.name: Plot_ID
fields.title: Plot_ID
fields.description: Identifier for the plot. Factor with 6 levels: C1, C2, C3, T1, T2 and T3. The C represents plots in the set-stocking treatment, and the T represents plots in the cell grazing treatment. The number is the block within the treatment

fields.name: Year
fields.title: Year
fields.description: Grazing year, running approximately spring to autumn

fields.name: Cohort_number
fields.title: Cohort_number
fields.description: Each cohort of cattle grazed on the experiment over two years, and then were replaced by younger stock. The Cohort_number indicates the group in which they grazed

fields.name: Grazing_number
fields.title: Grazing_number
fields.description: Cattle were grazed on the experiment over two years, and the Grazing_number indicates whether the measurement was taken in their first or second year

fields.name: Tag_Official
fields.title: Tag_Official
fields.description: The ear tag number that each animal must have in the UK to provide them with a unique identifier

fields.name: Tag_4
fields.title: Tag_4
fields.description: The last four digits of the Tag_official

fields.name: Breed
fields.title: Breed
fields.description: Cattle breed. Factor with 7 levels: Aberdeen Angus crossbred (AAX), British Blue crossbred (BRBX), Fleckvieh crossbred (FKVX), Hereford crosssbred (HEX), Montbelliarde crossbred (MOX), Simmental crossbread (SMX) and Stabiliser (ST).

fields.name: DOB
fields.title: DOB
fields.description: Date of birth of the animal

fields.name: Date_From
fields.title: Date_From
fields.description: The start of the date range over which the animal liveweight gain is being calculated. On this date, the animal weight was recorded (LWt_Start)

fields.name: Date_To
fields.title: Date_To
fields.description: The end of the date range over which the animal liveweight gain is being calculated. On this date, the animal weight was recorded (LWt_End). Except for the first period in which liveweight gain is calculated in a Year, the Date_To becomes the Date_From for the subsequent period of liveweight gain calculation

fields.name: LWt_Start
fields.title: LWt_Start
fields.description: The liveweight mass of the animal at the start of the date range (Date_From) over which animal liveweight gain is being calculated

fields.name: LWt_End
fields.title: LWt_End
fields.description: The liveweight mass of the animal at the end of the date range (Date_To) over which animal liveweight gain is being calculated. Except for the first period in which liveweight gain is calculated in a Year, the LWt_End becomes the LWt_Start for the subsequent period of liveweight gain calculation

fields.name: DLWG
fields.title: DLWG
fields.description: Daily liveweight gain, representing the change in mass over the period. Calculated as (LWt_End - LWt_Start) / (Date_To - Date_From)

title: Individual animal liveweight and daily liveweight gain, and pasture herbage mass recorded in a dairy x beef grazing study comparing contrasting grazing methods: set-stocked versus cell-grazed on a temperate permanent pasture.
description: This dataset provides measures of pasture herbage mass (commonly referred as cover), livestock performance (cattle liveweight and daily liveweight gain) and land productivity (liveweight gained per hectare) from a 8.25 ha replicated cattle grazing experiment comparing the effect of set-stocking versus cell grazing, where grazing intensity is higher but animals are moved more regularly. The data are from a 7-year study in the SW of the United Kingdom.
